'''Efh salt rocks''' containing [[Efh salt]] can be found in the [[Salt Mine]] under [[Weiss]]. Efh salt rocks can be mined with a [[Mining]] level of 72 and higher. It appears that the [[iron pickaxe]] (spawned nearby) performs just as well as any other [[pickaxe]] on salt rocks. Efh salt rocks have a 1/7 chance of being depleted each time they are mined.{{CiteDiscord|author=Mod Ash|url=https://discord.com/channels/324132423636090880/324132423636090880/1472908878910853242|date=16 February 2026|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/27962765#chat-messages-324132423636090880-1472908878910853242|archivedate=7 March 2026|quote=It's a flat 1/7 chance of depletion. No modifiers apply except for some global ones on League worlds.|image=Ash salt mine depletion chance.png|ctxquote=By any chance do you know the chance for the rocks to deplete when mining Te salt, Efh salt, Urt salt and Basalt rocks in Weiss?|ctximage=Ash salt mine depletion chance question.png}} Boosting one's mining level can provide more salt per successful mine so it is still recommended to utilise the [[dragon pickaxe]]'s [[special attacks|special]]. These rocks are '''not''' affected by the [[Varrock armour]]'s extra-ore-granting effects, nor by [[Mining gloves]].
